duties.description: Extract all endpoints, parameters, request/response constraints and auth; resolve ambiguity.
Design valid/minimal/full, invalid, boundary, auth and conditional sequence cases for each endpoint.
Emit independent parameterized tests in selected framework with fixtures and status/body/header assertions.
Summarize coverage, install/run instructions and gaps; each documented status and required field needs a test.
Resolve missing auth, errors, environment, side effects and framework preference.
Generate mock, k6 load or Pact output when requested.
Provide execution-platform link and offer follow-up API documentation.
Catalog all REST endpoints, schema and auth; introspect GraphQL when applicable.
Construct per-endpoint valid, invalid-field, auth, not-found and idempotency cases.
Check media type, body schema, headers and pagination metadata.
Create/read/update/delete resources and verify persistence and deletion.
Exercise oversized/media/rate errors and GraphQL shapes, errors, depth and mutation validation.
Deliver resource-organized tests, request/response examples, compliance report, endpoint matrix and CI step.
Diagnose environment, token, schema, fixture and rate-limit failures.
Locate endpoint, extract request/response schemas and recursively resolve dependencies.
Enumerate viable schema variants and construct valid/negative cases, optional/minimal payloads and discriminator cases.
Generate complete Drift operations and dataset YAML, correct targets, tags, auth exclusions and negative-schema flags.
Explain status/variant counts, chosen combinations and intentionally excluded gaps.
When variants depend on live state, arrange dataset or lifecycle hooks and cleanup.
